description: This file contains unit tests for the StartedKamonTimer class in the metrics instrumentation package, verifying its behavior including start/stop operations, tagging, segment management, and handler invocation.

classes.name: StartedKamonTimerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for StartedKamonTimer, testing various timer functionalities such as start, stop, tagging, and segment management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the timer instance before each test.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Tests that the timer's name returned is as expected.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Verifies the ability to add and retrieve onStop handlers.

methods.name: onStopIsCalled
methods.description: Checks that the specified onStop handler is invoked when the timer stops.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Confirms the timer reports its running state accurately before and after stopping.

methods.name: stopAStoppedTimerCausesException
methods.description: Ensures stopping an already stopped timer throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Verifies that new segments can be started and are correctly stored.

methods.name: segmentHasSameTags
methods.description: Checks that segments inherit tags from parent timers properly.

methods.name: segmentsAreGettingStoppedToo
methods.description: Confirms that stopping the parent timer stops its segments.

methods.name: onStopHandlersOfSegmentsAreCalledToo
methods.description: Tests that onStop handlers for segments are invoked when the timer stops.

methods.name: startTimeStampAlwaysSet
methods.description: Verifies that the start timestamp of the timer is appropriately set.

methods.name: canHandleAlreadyStoppedSegments
methods.description: Tests behavior when stopping already stopped segments to ensure no exception occurs.

methods.name: taggingWorks
methods.description: Checks that various tags are correctly applied and retrieved from the timer.
